findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-uptime-web-reader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_address, check_email_batch, url_uptime_ping, url_uptime_ping_batch, doc_read · Private data: check_email_address · Public sink: check_email_address, check_email_batch, url_uptime_ping_batch, doc_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_address, check_email_batch, url_uptime_ping, url_uptime_ping_batch, doc_read · Private data: check_email_address · Public sink: check_email_address, check_email_batch, url_uptime_ping_batch, doc_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
